item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'i zla tshes la ge ta brag ces ke'u seng ge rdzong nyi ma rang shar gyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug tu rigs mthun gyi mkha' 'gro bstan pa'i yon bdag dang grwa slob bdun dang bcas te song nas/ zab mo gter la drangs pa'o/ slar zla tshes rang la bstan pa'i yon bdag bsod nams gyis 'byor ba'i pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbu rtse nas/ shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur bas bstan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par gyur cig/
